block.fangsu.ticket_barrier.desc: Ticket gate for entering/exiting the paid area. Right-click the front of the gate while holding a Single Journey Ticket or IC Card to pass. Supports MTR fare, fixed fare and custom fare zone modes. Use a Brush to flip entrance/exit and the facing, or a Wrench to open the configuration screen
block.fangsu.screendoor_door.desc: The movable door panel of a platform screen door. Syncs with MTR train doors automatically. Use a Wrench to configure the model and the opening side (left/right/flexible)
block.fangsu.screendoor_glass.desc: The fixed glass panel of a platform screen door, opens and closes with the door panels to form a full platform screen. Use a Wrench to configure the model, or a Brush to toggle it manually
block.fangsu.duanmen.desc: End door at the end of a platform. Right-click to open/close it, or use a Brush. Use a Wrench to configure the model
block.fangsu.sign.desc: Free-standing sign. Use a Brush to open the editor and add text and images, edit front and back faces, multi-line layouts and poles. Use a Wrench to configure the model and offset
block.fangsu.sign_on_wall.desc: Single-sided sign placed on a wall. Use a Brush to open the editor and edit text and images. Use a Wrench to configure the model and offset
block.fangsu.pids.desc: Passenger Information Display System. Use a Wrench to open the configuration screen and select platforms (up to 16) to show train arrival information automatically. Supports JS scripts for custom drawing
block.fangsu.diaoban.desc: Hanging information panel. Use a Wrench to configure the drawing function and route, or a Brush to cycle arrow directions. Syncs with train doors
block.fangsu.route_info_sign.desc: Route information sign. Use a Wrench to configure and select a route, and the route map is drawn automatically. Use a Brush to cycle the entry/exit arrow direction
block.fangsu.station_info_sign.desc: Station information board. Use a Wrench to configure and select a station, and its information is displayed automatically
block.fangsu.adv_board.desc: Advertising board. Use a Wrench to open the configuration screen and set an image or GIF to play
block.fangsu.ticket_machine.desc: Two-block-tall ticket vending machine. Right-click to open the purchase screen and buy Single Journey Tickets by quantity and price
Central control for platform screen doors. Scans nearby screendoors on placement. Right-click to open the control screen to open/close or isolate the doors, with indicator lights showing the status
block.fangsu.rotating_rail.desc: Special rail block. Use a Wrench to open the configuration screen to choose between straight/curved/rotating modes and a rail model. Redstone signals control the rail offset
block.fangsu.collision_compensation_bloc: Invisible helper block. Placing it near object blocks projects their collision shapes onto itself and fixes click interaction, for models with mismatched collision boxes. Visible while holding this block or a Brush
item.fangsu.single_journey_ticket.desc: A single journey ticket bought from a ticket machine. Right-click the front of a gate while holding it to enter, the fare is deducted by zone and the ticket is consumed on exit
item.fangsu.ic_card.desc: A reusable stored-value card. Right-click the front of a gate while holding it to enter/exit, charged by zone. You cannot exit with insufficient balance
item.fangsu.wrench.desc: Configuration tool for FangSu blocks. Right-click a block to open its configuration screen (model selection, offset/rotation, extra settings)
item.fangsu.hybrid_creator.desc: Bulk rail construction tool. Right-click to open the task list editor and configure slice tasks, then left-click both ends of a rail to build them in bulk
